title: Run concurrent checks with one signed-in identity
when: Several workers need the same browser identity on one machine
need: Each check copies the authoritative sign-in state into a private browser. Interactive steps carry check_id and keep_open until the last step, or close through qa browser stop. An RPC failure, failed browser step or required cleanup failure makes qa browser step exit nonzero. If cleanup fails after a completed step, stdout retains its JSON receipt and stderr reports the cleanup failure. Cases close automatically; abandoned copies are swept after their owner exits. Authorize again when the authoritative sign-in expires, then start a new check. Inspect only that check with qa browser status --check-id ID; default readiness never probes the authoritative profile's daemon.
